name: Healing Helps

The only bright spot is a 34.04% week-over-week lift in GA4 activity, suggesting some organic website interest remains.

performance.verdict: No paid activity in 28 days; organic barely holding; account dormant.

findings.text: Zero spend, zero leads, zero paid clicks across all channels for the full 28-day window — no efficiency to measure; account is effectively off.
GBP actions collapsed 94.44% week-over-week; last 3 days show 0 actions vs a prior-week peak of 11 on 2026-08-25 — signal is a hard drop, not noise.
GA4 sessions spiked to 28 on 2026-09-01 vs a 3-7 daily baseline, then fell back to 6 on 2026-09-03 — a one-day anomaly, not a trend; cause unknown.
205 GA4 sessions and 42 GBP actions in 28 days produced 0 GA4 conversions — the conversion event is either broken or unmapped, masking any real intent.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing immediately — confirm ownership, suspension status, and category to explain the 94.44% action drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped 94.44% week-over-week and have read 0 for the last 3 consecutive days (2026-09-01 through 2026-09-03). Check the listing for suspension, ownership issues, or a category change that cut visibility. Success is confirmed when daily GBP actions return to the prior baseline of 3-6/day; re-check by 2026-09-07.

suggestions.text: Verify GA4 conversion event firing — 205 sessions and 0 conversions over 28 days indicates a broken or unmapped goal.
suggestions.monday_update: The account recorded 205 GA4 sessions and 167 users over 28 days with zero conversion events registering. Test the conversion trigger on the live form or thank-you page and confirm events fire in GA4 DebugView. Success is at least 1 confirmed conversion event recorded; verify by 2026-09-07.

suggestions.text: Watch the 2026-09-01 GA4 session spike (28 sessions, 4x baseline) — identify referral source before attributing value.
suggestions.monday_update: Sessions jumped to 28 on 2026-09-01 against a consistent 3-7/day baseline then dropped back to 6 by 2026-09-03. Pull the traffic source/medium breakdown in GA4 for that date to determine if this was a referral, direct, or bot spike. No action until source is identified; re-check by 2026-09-07.
